briefdescription.para: RFP-01: Basic add / isRevoked round-trip after Phase 2/3 hardening.
RFP-02: Empty JTI is rejected with REVOCATION_ENTRY_INVALID.

detaileddescription.para: An empty JTI cannot meaningfully identify a token; accepting it would allow silent revocation of every token that lacks a jti claim.

briefdescription.para: RFP-03: JTI exceeding kMaxJtiBytes (1024) is rejected with REVOCATION_ENTRY_INVALID.
RFP-04: purgeExpired removes expired entries; non-expired entries survive.
RFP-05: Concurrent add() and isRevoked() are thread-safe.
RFP-06: Re-adding the same JTI is idempotent (no exception, LWW semantics).
RFP-07: isRevoked() returns false for a JTI that was never added.
RFP-08: After an entry expires and purgeExpired runs, isRevoked() returns false.
FED-01: validateToken for a token with an unknown issuer throws FEDERATION_UNKNOWN_REALM (not JWT_ISSUER_MISMATCH).

detaileddescription.para: Phase 2/3 hardened the error classification: callers can now distinguish "no such realm" from "realm exists but token is invalid".

briefdescription.para: FED-02: Registering the same issuer URL twice throws AUTH_CONFIG_INVALID.
FED-03: A token that is not a valid JWT (no dot separators) throws JWT_INVALID_FORMAT before any realm lookup.
FED-06: realmProvider for an unknown issuer throws FEDERATION_UNKNOWN_REALM.
FED-07: Multiple realms coexist; realmCount() reflects additions.
FED-08: realmCount() starts at 0 and increments correctly.
ASY-01: createSession with empty user_id throws std::invalid_argument.

detaileddescription.para: The contract requires user_id to be non-empty; an empty subject would produce an anonymous session with no deterministic ownership.

briefdescription.para: ASY-02: validateSession for a completely unknown session ID returns valid=false without throwing.
ASY-03: validateSession for a session with an expired absolute timeout returns valid=false with a populated reason string.
ASY-04: terminateSession for a non-existent session ID is idempotent.
ASY-05: terminateAllOtherSessions removes non-kept sessions and preserves the specified keep session.
ASY-06: All session IDs created by createSession() start with "sess_".

detaileddescription.para: The "sess_" prefix is part of the public contract: downstream components that route or filter session tokens rely on this prefix.

briefdescription.para: ASY-07: pruneExpired removes expired sessions; active sessions are unaffected.
ASY-08: Per-user session limit is enforced; creating a session beyond the limit evicts the oldest session for that user.
Phase 4 focused regression tests for auth hardening delivery.

detaileddescription.para: Covers three test families mapped to the three roadmap items:

RFP-01 Add + isRevoked round-trip (baseline sanity after Phase 2/3 hardening) RFP-02 Empty JTI rejected by add() with REVOCATION_ENTRY_INVALID RFP-03 JTI exceeding kMaxJtiBytes (1024) rejected by add() with REVOCATION_ENTRY_INVALID RFP-04 purgeExpired removes expired entries; valid entries survive RFP-05 Concurrent add() and isRevoked() are thread-safe (no crash, no data race) RFP-06 Re-adding the same JTI is idempotent (LWW semantics, no exception) RFP-07 isRevoked() returns false for an unknown JTI (not revoked by default) RFP-08 Expired JTI reports false after expiry passes purgeExpired

FED-01 Unknown realm throws FEDERATION_UNKNOWN_REALM (not JWT_ISSUER_MISMATCH) FED-02 Duplicate realm registration throws AUTH_CONFIG_INVALID FED-03 Token that is not a valid JWT (no dot separators) throws JWT_INVALID_FORMAT FED-06 realmProvider for unknown issuer throws FEDERATION_UNKNOWN_REALM FED-07 Multiple realms coexist; correct realm selected by issuer FED-08 realmCount() reflects realm additions correctly

ASY-01 SessionManager::createSession with empty user_id throws std::invalid_argument ASY-02 validateSession for unknown session_id returns valid=false (no throw) ASY-03 validateSession for expired session returns valid=false with reason ASY-04 terminateSession for unknown session_id is idempotent (no throw) ASY-05 terminateAllOtherSessions terminates only the non-kept sessions ASY-06 Session ID prefix invariant: all created sessions start with "sess_" ASY-07 pruneExpired removes expired sessions; active sessions survive ASY-08 Per-user session limit enforced: oldest session evicted when limit exceeded
